title: Prove sharp ADDRESS tariff margins for every odd kernel (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped arithmetic proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. Extend Wentao Li's PR3702 ADDRESS coefficient-bit comparison:

```diff
- five non-dyadic kernels, exponents j=0,...,32
+ every odd q>=3, every integer j>=0
+ q=3 uniquely minimizes the excess at each exponent
```

The sharp fused excess is 14 at j=0, 20 at j=1 and 24 at j>=2. The sharp baseline excess is 16, 24 and 32 respectively. Global minimum excesses 14 and 16 occur only at (q,j)=(3,0). Those global numeric values were already observed on the predecessor grid; the new result is uniform validity, the exponent-dependent bounds and uniqueness. Either sign of every query power has the same bill.

The proof reduces the six rational coefficients to four exact bit-length cases. No larger kernel or exponent search can improve this named tariff. A changed lowering or physical encoding is required to escape this particular obstruction. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Credit Wentao Li / VictorLiwentao for PR3702's tariff and lowering, PR2687's interface, PR2593 and PR840, with Karl Appel / PR521, commdata2338 / PR677 and the retained ADDRESS/DATA lineage. James Reed's PR3704/3752 retain the finite comparison and margin. Their scientific executables are neither imported nor replayed. SOURCES.json pins the predecessor README and tariff as historical provenance at canonical main 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3702, PR3704 and PR3752 explicitly restrict their comparisons to five non-dyadic kernels and j=0,...,32.
- After: PROOF.md proves the all-parameter statement. The standalone exact checker compares Fraction coefficient charges with the new integer formulas on 20,440 dense fixtures and 640 power-boundary fixtures. It checks sharpness at 1,024 exponents, 1,024 dyadic references, fourteen invalid inputs and seven false-formula/stronger-margin controls. Fixture families overlap.
- Local normal and optimized direct checks both print `PASS_UNIFORM_ODD_KERNEL_MARGINS`, in 0.342 and 0.339 seconds. Both registered commands pass; the complete launcher takes 0.876 seconds. These timings establish timeout headroom, not a speedup claim.
- Metadata/source pins, committed bytes/source ancestry, official export integrity/input coverage, and read-only Git-free normal/optimized export replays pass. All seven exported files retain their bytes and modes. Generated receipts bind all six package files; no receipt was handwritten.

From the repository root, use CPython 3.12 with the standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/uniform-odd-kernel-margins/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/uniform-odd-kernel-margins/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/uniform-odd-kernel-margins
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/uniform-odd-kernel-margins --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace the local installation. Each registered command has a 60-second timeout. The direct checker writes nothing.

## Limitations

This is a proof for one coefficient-table proxy, not a fully charged supplier or a complete multiplication theorem. No optimal lowering, alternate tariff, native hosting, routing, restoration or selected assumption is proved. The universal claim rests on the written arithmetic proof, not finite extrapolation. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run; all five framework assumptions remain.

## Related open work

No open PR found studies this ADDRESS coefficient-bit tariff or its kernel/exponent minima. The overlap checkpoint covered all 522 cached open PR bodies plus a fresh latest-100 list, live handoffs, canonical-main READMEs and merged-object searches. Sparse local notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain limits. PR3702/3704/3752 are merged predecessors with a finite scope, not competing open work.

The completion refresh screened all twelve account open PRs created since the CLAIM, including this one. The other eleven concern derived phases, Gaussian rounding, shared atom powers, parity fanout, algebra automorphisms, E8 geometry, local polynomial factors and replay runtime. None studies this ADDRESS coefficient-bit quantity or reports a competing value. No additional computations audited those results.

## Open next questions

Does a specific physically justified coefficient encoding change the cheapest odd kernel? First derive its complete code-length bill for the same six coefficients. No alternate tariff or hosting implementation is supplied, and no continuation is reserved.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/uniform-odd-kernel-margins)`, passed at exact head `7ae7ba0a361fa68b007218d70a5d1d0680fe8101` in [run 41617294841](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41617294841). The completed checks were read once; separate run metadata confirms the same head, completed status and success. All registered commands also passed locally. Hosted execution certifies the declared finite checks and source bindings, not independent acceptance of the universal written proof. There are no locally unrun package checks.

Advance CLAIM: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19371215
